Ice Spear ThrustBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of Direct DMG by 16% of Boreas's Max HP each to a single enemy.
Arctic Blade Lv.3Grants all allies 3 layers of [Ice Wings Spread] at the beginning of each wave. At the beginning of allies’ turns, they gain 1 layer of [Ice Wings Spread], which can still be triggered after Boreas dies. When any ally is revived, they gain 100% Turn Meter. Afterward, grants all allies 1 layer of [Ice Wings Spread]. When Boreas proactively launches basic attacks or casts active skills, he will pursue and attack the target with an additional basic attack or active skill once.
Intense Icicle AttackActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
